# Beer-UK

> A modded, softcore, raidable UK Rust server. Monthly wipes on the first Thursday (following Facepunch's forced wipe), admin-run surprise events, and an active Discord community. 25 player cap, procedural map.

Beer-UK is a community-run Rust game server aimed at players who want a proper, ongoing community rather than a server that empties out after wipe week. Admins run unscheduled live events (e.g. mass supply signal drops) and tune loot so early game isn't a slog and late game doesn't trivialise everything.

## Key facts

- Server IP: 198.244.225.11:28015
- Wipe schedule: monthly, first Thursday of the month, 18:00 GMT (19:00 during British Summer Time)
- Player cap: 25
- Map: Procedural
- Style: Modded, softcore, raidable

## Pages

- [Home](https://beer-uk.co.uk/): server overview, live stats, direct-connect button
- [Map](https://beer-uk.co.uk/map): current wipe's procedural map — seed, world size, monuments
- [Rules](https://beer-uk.co.uk/rules): full server rules
- [Apply](https://beer-uk.co.uk/apply): staff applications, ban appeals, general contact
